title: Revisited Cold Gas Content with Atomic Carbon [C I] in z = 2.5 Protocluster Galaxies
question: Whether the same molecular gas mass calibration used for field galaxies can be applied to protocluster galaxies at z = 2.49 using [C I] (1-0), CO (3-2), and dust continuum.

data.sensitivity: 0.10 mJy beam^-1 at 80 km s^-1 around phase center (natural weighting)

what.value: Previous CO (3-2), CO (4-3), and 1.1 mm dust continuum observations and galaxy properties (M_star, SFR) of the protocluster HAEs

evidence.quote: In this Paper, we perform a [CI] line search by targeting main-sequence galaxies associated with a protocluster at z = 2.49, where CO and dust emissions are already detected (Lee et al. 2017, 2019, hereafter we refer to these two papers as Paper I and Paper II, respectively).

recipe.goal: Calibrate visibility data, image [C I] cubes, subtract continuum, and apply primary beam correction
recipe.method: Calibrate visibilities with ALMA pipeline in CASA 4.7.0; image with tclean in CASA 5.6.1 down to 2 sigma using 1'' circular masks with natural weighting and uvtapers (0''.3, 0''.5, 0''.9) at 80 km/s (and 50 km/s) binning; extract 10''x10'' subcubes, subtract continuum in image plane with imcontsub (fitorder=0), and apply primary beam correction.
key_parameters: deconvolution threshold = 2 sigma, CLEAN mask = 1'' radius circular region
natural weighting and uvtaper = 0''.3, 0''.5, 0''.9; velocity resolution = 80 km s^-1 (default) or 50 km s^-1 (HAE 8)

recipe.goal: Apply detection criteria and measure line and continuum fluxes (including reanalysis of CO and 1.1 mm dust)
recipe.method: Select candidates with peak integrated intensity S/N >= 4.5, then require peak flux density >= 3.5 sigma or >= 2 continuous channels > 2.5 sigma; measure total fluxes via 2D Gaussian fitting with CASA imfit in circular apertures (0''.7 or 1''.0) chosen from growth curves, or 1D Gaussian fitting for HAE 4b; reanalyze CO (3-2), CO (4-3), and 1.1 mm dust with the same procedure.
key_parameters: HAE 3 and HAE 16: 0''.3-tapered map, 1''.0 aperture; HAE 4: natural-weighted map, 0''.7 aperture; HAE 8 and HAE 9: 0''.5-tapered map, 1''.0 aperture
CO (3-2): natural weighting, 1''.0 aperture; 1.1 mm dust: 0''.5 taper, 1''.0 aperture; CO (4-3): same imaging parameters and apertures as [C I]
assumptions: For non-detections without any line detection, assume FWHM = 300 km s^-1, natural weighting, and 0''.7 aperture for 3 sigma upper limits; if CO is detected, assume the CO (4-3) line width and aperture.

recipe.goal: Fit L'_CO vs L'_[CI](1-0) luminosity relations
recipe.method: Fit linear relations in log-log space between L'_CO(4-3) or L'_CO(3-2) and L'_[CI](1-0) for literature samples and for six secure protocluster galaxies (with variable and fixed slopes) using orthogonal distance regression.
key_parameters: Include non-detections as 3 sigma upper limits with 1 sigma noise uncertainties; test variable slope and fixed slopes (a = 1.04, 1.32).
assumptions: LambdaCDM cosmology with H_0 = 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_m = 0.3, Omega_Lambda = 0.7.

recipe.goal: Derive and cross-calibrate molecular gas masses from [C I], CO (3-2), and 1.1 mm dust
recipe.method: Calculate M_mol from [C I] using Equation (1), from CO (3-2) using R_13 and alpha_CO, and from 1.1 mm dust using the Scoville et al. (2016) calibration; compare the three tracers against galaxy properties and PDR models.
key_parameters: R_13 = 1.9, alpha_CO = 4.36 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1 (no metallicity correction); T_d = 25 K for dust
assumptions: Optically thin [C I] (1-0) with Q_10 = 0.35, log(X_CI) = -4.8, R_13 = 1.9, Milky Way-like alpha_CO = 4.36 without metallicity correction, T_d = 25 K, Chabrier (2003) IMF.

recipe.goal: Analyze gas depletion time scale scaling relations vs stellar mass
recipe.method: Compute [C I]-based gas depletion time scales (tau_depl = M_gas / SFR), normalize by field scaling relations from Scoville et al. (2017), Tacconi et al. (2018), and Liu et al. (2019), and compute Spearman rank correlation coefficients with stellar mass.
key_parameters: Include [C I] non-detections with CO (4-3) detections for galaxies with log(M_star/M_sun) > 9.5 using 3 sigma upper limits.
assumptions: [C I] line width for non-detections equals CO (4-3) line width.

evidence.quote: Using the calibration adopted for field main-sequence galaxies, the [C I ] -based gas measurements are lower than or comparable to the CO-based gas measurements by -0.35 dex at the lowest with the mean deviation of -0.14 dex.

answer_key.quantity: Mean gas mass difference of [C I] vs dust

evidence.quote: The differences between [C I ] - and the dust- based measurements are relatively mild by up to 0.16 dex with the mean difference of 0.02 dex.

evidence.quote: We find negative Spearman coefficient values ( p -value) of -0.81 (0.008, Scoville et al. 2017), -0.68 (0.04, Tacconi et al. 2018), -0.53 (0.14, Liu et al. 2019), when the 3 σ upper limits are all taken into account.
